subject: Re: Quick reconvene — secure 20m technical sync this week?
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta@integrahealth.io>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick reconvene — secure 20m technical sync this week?

Hi Marta —

Great to meet you and the team on the discovery call earlier. Appreciated the context on your ingestion volume and the need for predictable tail latency for the clinical assistant use case. Per our quick notes, next steps are:

- 20m technical walkthrough with an engineer + solutions lead to validate integration patterns and SLOs
- Share a short pre-demo checklist so we can prepare sample inputs
- Confirm any compliance guardrails (we noted SSO + customer-managed KMS)

I have three tight windows this week that keep our engineering lead aligned with availability — can you please pick one and reply within 24 hours so we can lock the slot? If none work, tell me a preferred day next week and I’ll rearrange.

Options (all PT):
- Wed 9/29 — 11:00–11:20 AM
- Thu 9/30 — 2:30–2:50 PM
- Fri 10/1 — 9:00–9:20 AM

If you confirm, I’ll send a calendar invite with the agenda and attach a short checklist for the session. Attached: discovery notes and a pre-demo checklist (stubs).

Thanks — looking forward to continuing the conversation.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: 2026-09-28-discovery-notes.pdf (summary), pre-demo-checklist.md
From: Marta Ruiz <marta@integrahealth.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, procurement@integrahealth.io
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 12:47:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Quick reconvene — secure 20m technical sync this week?

Hi Ben —

Thanks for the follow-up and for the clear next steps. Apologies — our CTO had an unexpected board prep conflict and we weren't able to make the call today. We still want to move forward; engineering will need to attend the technical walkthrough.

The proposed times are close but two items: I’m out Wed morning and Thu afternoon is tough for our infra lead. Could you do any of the following instead (ET)?

- Thu 9/30 — 5:30–5:50 PM ET
- Fri 10/1 — 12:00–12:20 PM ET
- Mon 10/4 — 10:00–10:20 AM ET

Also: procurement asked whether a high-level SoW will be shared ahead of the session (they don’t need legal level detail, just scope bullets).

Thanks,
Marta Ruiz
Head of Product Ops, Integra Health
marta@integrahealth.io
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 08:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick reconvene — secure 20m technical sync this week?

Marta —

Thanks for the note and the availability. Totally understand the CTO conflict — thanks for flagging the attendee requirements. We can accommodate engineering.

I can do Friday 10/1 at 9:00 AM PT / 12:00 PM ET (your 2nd option) — that’s our preferred alignment to keep the infra lead on the call. I’ll attach a one-page scope summary for procurement and send a calendar invite once you confirm.

If you can confirm by EOD tomorrow (9/30), I’ll lock the slot; otherwise I’ll open the slot for other prospects to keep our engineering calendar tidy.

--
